item.title: Verbose beta 248
item.description:
A new look, and fewer places to look

Also on iPhone

  • Transcripts have the new look: serif text, colored speaker chips, and a glass player.
  • The recorder has the new look: the kind in serif and a persimmon clock.
  • Minimized, a recording shows its time with Pause and Stop in the tab bar.
  • Settings has the new look: colored icons, values on the right, and switches in a card.
  • The You page shows your week, About me, your voice, and cleanup in cards.
  • Recordings use your AirPods when they're connected, at full quality on iOS 26.
  • Tap the microphone in the recorder to record from another one.
  • Home's tiles have quiet line patterns, and the record disc sits centered in its rings.
  • Clean up in Recent is a smaller text button beside the recording's title.
  • The tab bar has the new look, with Record above it on every tab but Home.
  • Thoughts, By day, Templates, Ask, Dictations, and Dictionary have the new look.
  • Verbose has one look. The Look setting is gone; Palette chooses full color or soft tints.
  • The keyboard has the new look: card keys, ink letters, and a persimmon dictate button.
  • Widgets and the Live Activity have the new look: cards, serif titles, and the record disc.
  • A minimized recording stays in view on transcripts and Audio only recordings.
  • A recording that moves to the iPhone microphone uses that microphone's settings.
  • VoiceOver reads your words for each day of the week on the You page.
  • An answer from Ask says again how many passages and recordings it read.
